full_judgment: 29. PW 1 Harun-ur-Rashid deposed that the defendant No. 31, Khaled Solaiman, took lease 7 ganders of land from the original land-lord. In cross examination, he admitted that there is no patta or registered deed in support of such settlement; that he was not present at the time of settlement nor has he any knowledge about that settlement.
